info.name: Restaurant Final - Presentation Steps 01-12
info.description: Run the FULL collection in order, one iteration. Mirrors presentation checklist steps 1-12. Runtime variables keep tokens and test passwords local to the run. Requires seeded restaurants and an existing application admin. Creates two unique ordinary test users per run; deletes only its own three demo reservations. Leaves all pre-existing users and bookings intact. Logout clears cookie, not copied Bearer JWTs.

exec: pm.test('Contains member booking B', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(r => r._id === pm.variables.get('adminTargetId') && r.user === pm.variables.get('ownerId'))).to.eql(true));
